_comment: A deliberate ceiling, not a target. Growth is a decision: raise a number here in the same commit that adds the coverage, and say why. After a clean full run `just ratchet` tightens every ceiling back to what the suite really uses, so room to grow never builds up unnoticed. max_single_test_s is CI-runner headroom (the desktop's slowest test is ~10 s); a test that needs more belongs in the heavy lane (.config/nextest.toml default-filter).
